# Airod Heating & Air Conditioning

> Heating & air conditioning based in San Antonio, Texas. Owner Dustin Buchanan and his crew serve Far West San Antonio with free estimates, same-day repairs and clean Carrier and Goodman installs, with no upselling.

- Phone: (210) 760-8319
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Alamo Ranch, Helotes, Leon Valley, Castroville
- Google rating: 4.7 from 38 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/airod-heating-air-conditioning/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/airod-heating-air-conditioning/book.html

## Services
- AC repair: Capacitors, compressors and refrigerant problems diagnosed and fixed, often the same day.
- AC & heat pump replacement: Major-brand systems installed and tested, sometimes within hours of the first call.
- Gas furnaces & full systems: Complete gas HVAC systems for homes with 20- and 40-year-old units.
- Air handler installs: Indoor air handlers set in the closet, sealed and matched to the outdoor unit.
- Ductwork & duct sealing: Duct repair and replacement in the attic or crawl space, sealed so the air goes where it should.
- Maintenance & second opinions: System cleaning and check-ups, or a free second look before you commit to a replacement.

## About
Airod Heating & Air Conditioning is owned by Dustin Buchanan and based in Far West San Antonio, off Kristidawn near Alamo Ranch. Dustin often takes the call, troubleshoots the system and writes the estimate himself, and estimates are free. His team includes technician Mando and Jackie in the office. The work runs from capacitor and refrigerant fixes to heat pump changeouts and complete gas HVAC systems, for homeowners and San Antonio real estate investors. Reviewers mention careful installs, no upselling and crews that clean up before they leave.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Are estimates free?
  A: Yes. Airod gives free estimates on repairs and replacements, and reviewers say the quotes were fair.
- Q: How fast can you get to Alamo Ranch or Far West San Antonio?
  A: Airod is based in 78253, so many calls get a same-day or next-day visit. One customer had Dustin at the door in 15 minutes.
- Q: What brands do you install?
  A: Major brands including Carrier and Goodman, and reviewers mention a full warranty on their new system.
- Q: Do you replace gas furnaces too?
  A: Yes. Airod installs complete gas HVAC systems, including homes with two systems replaced at once.
- Q: Do you work with real estate investors?
  A: Yes. San Antonio investors use Airod across multiple homes.
- Q: Can you give me a second opinion?
  A: Yes. Dustin will look at the system and tell you honestly whether it needs a repair or a replacement.
